text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Prior to the Oka Sho,
Phalaenopsis entered 
a GⅠ race. 
And there, she—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Heh, and here I thought it was 
premature... 
—Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
It seems they were stronger 
than I had anticipated.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
A step ahead of the rest—I have claimed 
victory.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“Congratulations...! Congratulations, 
Phalaeno!”

text_block_list.name: Club Female Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Incredible... You're amazing, 
Phalaeno-san! 
A first GⅠ win, something we only dreamed 
of...!

text_block_list.name: Club Female Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, what do I do... My chest feels so... 
*sniff*. 
I can't... This is just hitting me right 
in the heart...

text_block_list.name: Club Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
*Sniff*... Hehe,
she's completely bawling. 
...Well, it makes sense. The instructors 
especially 
have been watching over Phalaeno-san for 
so long.

text_block_list.name: Club Male Staff A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... Truth is, she made us a promise 
long ago. 
That she would bring a GⅠ trophy home to 
the club—

text_block_list.name: Club Male Staff A
text_block_list.text:
—And she saw it through. 
Through earnest, steady effort,
she showed 
us with real results.

text_block_list.name: Club Male Staff A
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you, Phalaeno-san.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Good morning, Trainer... Hm,
what is this? 
It appears to be quite a splendid moth 
orchid.
choice_data_list: It arrived from the club just a li...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
From the club... Ah, I see. 
A celebratory gift, then.
choice_data_list: This just arrived from the club a ...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...If I am to speak of this race in 
earnest— 
it was nothing more than a stroke of good 
fortune.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Lacking the refinement required of an 
athlete, nonetheless... 
it was a victory forced through sheer 
will—one that cannot be replicated.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Thus, receiving such fanfare feels 
rather more than I deserve...
choice_data_list: Even so, you fulfilled your promise.
Even so, you fulfilled your promise.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
choice_data_list: Even so, you kept your promise.
Even so, you kept your promise.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As someone on the receiving end,
just like the club members, 
that was how I felt. The fact remained 
that Phalaenopsis had brought home a GⅠ 
victory.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even if she harbored misgivings herself— 
this joy was not diminished in the least.
choice_data_list: Hold your head high and accept it—...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
......Heh, you are right. 
What right do I have to brush aside 
everyone's 
kindness with my own selfish excuses?
choice_data_list: Hold your head high and accept the...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Shall we display it,
Trainer? Somewhere we 
may look upon this praise at any time.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
—So that whenever we stand before this 
orchid, 
we are filled with joy, and the will to 
fight.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Armed with both, we look ahead to the Oka 
Sho. 
There too, I shall claim victory.
choice_data_list: Yeah! Let's live up to their hopes...
Right! Let's live up to their hope...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. 
...Now, regarding this orchid—
choice_data_list: Yeah! Let's live up to their expec...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ...Yes, I shall entrust it to you.
choice_data_list: Leave taking care of the flowers t...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: If it is you, I know it is in good hands.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
......Heh. 
It truly is beautiful.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From that day on, beside the curtains in 
this room, 
the moth orchid bathed warmly in the 
sunlight.
